editorial:
Ever felt like you had your whole life planned out until a giant curveball hit you? You will love following this career-driven woman who has the perfect job and a great lifestyle, but feels like something is missing. She decides she wants a baby and goes on a mission to find the perfect father. She sets her sights on a sportswriter at her own magazine, and the chemistry between them is great. The movie has a light, funny vibe that feels like a cozy night in, blending romance with a bit of old-school corporate drama.

What really makes this work is the awkward tension after she tricks him into proposing, only to find out he cannot have children. The acting is natural, and the pacing keeps you interested without feeling rushed. While some of the 80s tropes feel a bit dated, the heart of the story still hits home. If you enjoy quirky rom-coms, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: After the shock of learning he is sterile, the couple has to decide if their love is more important than her dream of having a biological child. They eventually realize that their connection is too strong to throw away. They decide to stay together and find other ways to build a family, showing that love is about more than just genetics. It ends on a sweet, hopeful note where they embrace their future together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic 80s romantic comedies and stories about unexpected love.
